example_prompts: Founders own 60%, Series A put in $5M for 20% with a 1x non-participating preference, and the rest is a 20% option pool. What does everyone get at a $10M, $30M and $100M exit?
Explain liquidation preferences with numbers: I own 7M common shares, an investor holds 3M preferred shares for $6M, 1x non-participating. Show payouts at several exit prices.
At what exit price do founders stop being hurt by a 1x participating preference?
What do I take home if we sell for $25M? Founders 70%, seed investors 30% for $3M with a 2x preference.
